Its primary innovation is using a residual compression mechanism to reduce the space footprint of these late-interaction models by 6–10× while maintaining quality [colbertv2 §Abstract].

In summary, the RAG survey addresses how to segment documents into meaningful chunks for LLM consumption, whereas ColBERTv2 addresses how to efficiently represent and retrieve documents using compressed token-level vectors.
